svg.title: graph-falkordb module architecture
svg.desc: FalkorDB backend boundaries from graph-core contracts through jfalkordb sessions, Cypher builders, schema and merge support, result mapping, JVM algorithm fallbacks, and Redis-module storage.
svg.text: FalkorDB keeps graph-core contracts while using jfalkordb, Redis Graph commands, numeric ids, and JVM fallbacks.
Use FalkorDB for Redis Graph deployment with graph-core portability; use MERGE for upsert.
Choose another graph-core backend when repository-style DSL transactions or managed unique constraints are required.
